text: NovaVPN error E-1042 means the client certificate has expired. Open the NovaVPN tray icon, choose 'Renew certificate' and sign in again with SSO. Certificates are valid for 90 days.

NovaVPN error E-1043 appears when the internal DNS servers cannot be reached after connecting. Disconnect, run 'novavpn --flush-dns' and reconnect. If it persists, open a Helix ticket in the Network queue.
Para conectarte a la red corporativa desde casa necesitas NovaVPN instalado en un equipo gestionado. Los equipos personales no pueden usar la VPN por política de seguridad.
Split tunneling is disabled on NovaVPN. All traffic, including video calls, goes through the corporate gateway while the VPN is on.
La red Wi-Fi 'Nimbus-Staff' usa autenticación 802.1X con tu usuario corporativo. Los invitados deben usar 'Nimbus-Guest', que caduca a las 24 horas.
If the internet is very slow only while working from home, check your home router first: run the speed test in the Helix self-service portal and attach the result to your ticket.

If you no longer remember your password, open the self-service reset page on the intranet. You confirm who you are with the authenticator app on your phone and then pick a new passphrase of at least 14 characters.
After 5 failed sign-in attempts the account is locked for 30 minutes. Error E-2001 is shown on the sign-in page while the lock is active.
El doble factor (MFA) es obligatorio para todas las aplicaciones. Si cambias de teléfono, pide a Service Desk que restablezca tu método MFA antes de borrar el teléfono antiguo.
Single sign-on (SSO) is provided by NimbusID using SAML 2.0. New SaaS apps must be onboarded through the IAM team before employees can use SSO.
KeyRing error E-2210 means your vault is locked because the master key was entered incorrectly too many times. Wait 15 minutes or ask a KeyRing admin to unlock it.
En KeyRing puedes compartir credenciales con tu equipo creando una carpeta compartida. Nunca envíes contraseñas por chat o correo.
Passphrases must have at least 14 characters and expire every 365 days. Reusing any of your last 10 passphrases is blocked.
Orbit MDM error E-4115 during enrollment means the device serial number is not registered in the asset inventory. Send the serial number to the IT Asset team via Helix.
Si pierdes tu portátil o te lo roban, avisa a Seguridad en menos de 1 hora llamando a la extensión 4444. Bloquearemos el equipo de forma remota y borraremos los datos.
Laptops are replaced every 4 years. You will receive an email from IT Asset 30 days before your refresh date with a link to book the swap.
Personal phones can access email and chat only after installing the Orbit MDM work profile. The work profile keeps company data separate and can be wiped without touching personal photos.
Las impresoras de cada planta usan impresión segura: envías el trabajo a 'Nimbus-Print' y lo liberas acercando tu tarjeta al lector de la impresora.
Printer error E-6020 on Nimbus-Print devices means the badge reader cannot reach the print server. Use a printer on another floor and report the device ID in Helix.
Approved software is installed from the Software Center app. Anything not listed there needs a request in Helix with a business justification and manager approval.
Helix tickets use priorities P1 to P4. P1 means a full outage affecting many people and is answered within 15 minutes, 24/7.
El error E-5003 en Helix aparece al adjuntar archivos de más de 25 MB. Comprime el archivo o súbelo a la carpeta compartida y pega el enlace en el ticket.
If nobody has responded to your request after the expected time, you can ask for it to be escalated from the ticket page; the duty manager is notified automatically.
The Service Desk is staffed Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 20:00 CET. Outside those hours only P1 incidents are handled by the on-call engineer.
El catálogo de Helix agrupa las solicitudes por categoría: Accesos, Hardware, Software, Red y RR. HH. Elegir la categoría correcta acelera la asignación.
Full-time employees get 25 days of paid time off (PTO) per calendar year. Up to 5 unused PTO days can be carried over until March 31 of the next year.
Las vacaciones se solicitan en Portal Atlas, en la sección 'Mis ausencias'. Tu responsable recibe una notificación y debe aprobarlas al menos 10 días antes.
If you are ill, tell your manager before your shift starts and register the absence in Portal Atlas. A doctor's note is required from the third consecutive day.
El permiso por nacimiento es de 16 semanas para ambos progenitores. Las primeras 6 semanas son obligatorias e ininterrumpidas tras el parto.
Employees who become parents, including through adoption, receive 16 weeks of paid leave. Talk to your HR Business Partner at least 8 weeks before the due date.
PayFlow error E-3007 means the bank account number (IBAN) failed validation. Check that the IBAN has no spaces and belongs to a SEPA country, then save again.
La nómina se paga el último día hábil de cada mes. Puedes descargar tus recibos en PayFlow desde el menú 'Documentos'.
Business expenses are submitted in PayFlow Expenses within 30 days with a photo of the receipt. Meals are reimbursed up to 40 EUR per day when travelling.
La política de teletrabajo permite hasta 3 días por semana desde casa, acordados con tu responsable. Los martes son días presenciales para todo el equipo.
Working from another country for more than 10 days a year requires approval from HR and Legal because of tax and social security rules.
On your first day you will receive your laptop, badge and NimbusID credentials from your onboarding buddy. Complete the mandatory security training in Atlas Learn within 7 days.
Cuando un empleado deja la empresa, su responsable debe abrir la solicitud de baja en Helix con 5 días de antelación para revocar accesos y recoger el equipo.
Performance reviews (the 'Compass' cycle) run twice a year, in June and December. You write a self-assessment and your manager adds feedback in Portal Atlas.
Cada empleado dispone de un presupuesto de formación de 1.000 EUR al año. Solicítalo en Atlas Learn antes de inscribirte en el curso.
To report harassment or discrimination confidentially, use the SpeakUp line. Reports can be anonymous and are reviewed by an external ombudsperson, not by your management chain.
Health insurance through CareNet covers employees and their dependents from the first day. Add a dependent in Portal Atlas within 30 days of a life event.
El beneficio de bienestar reembolsa hasta 50 EUR al mes en gimnasios o apps de deporte. Sube la factura en PayFlow Expenses con la categoría 'Bienestar'.
Meeting rooms are booked in the Desk&Room app. Rooms not checked in within 10 minutes of the start time are released automatically.
Las plazas de aparcamiento se asignan por sorteo cada trimestre. Los vehículos eléctricos tienen prioridad en las plazas con cargador.
If you receive a suspicious email, do not click any link. Use the 'Report Phish' button in Outlook; the Security Operations Center (SOC) reviews every report within 1 hour.
Documents are classified as Public, Internal, Confidential or Restricted. Restricted data, such as salary files, must never be stored on personal devices or external drives.
Los puertos USB de almacenamiento están bloqueados en los equipos gestionados. Para transferir archivos grandes usa la herramienta corporativa de compartición de ficheros.
DocVault error E-7001 means you do not have permission to open the folder. Request access from the folder owner shown in the error dialog; IT cannot grant access to business folders.
Employees can request a copy of the personal data the company holds about them by emailing the Data Protection Officer (DPO). Requests are answered within 30 days, as required by GDPR.
Glosario interno: CAB es el Comité de Aprobación de Cambios, que se reúne cada jueves. Ningún cambio en producción se despliega sin aprobación del CAB salvo emergencias P1.
During the year-end change freeze, from December 15 to January 7, only emergency changes approved by the CAB can be deployed.
